wholePhysicalScope: The Easter 2011 exterior of Westport House, with grey limestone, Cassels east frontage, the pedimented south front, slate roofs and chimney stacks, and the west lake terrace.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the limestone fronts, south pediment, slate roof stacks and west terrace. Near levels add sash reveals, finials and balustrades.
limitations: The two exact Qualla images show the south and west faces in Easter weekend 2011. Camera timestamps give April 23. The boating-lake caption gives Easter Sunday.

The named footprint fixes the manor’s principal mass. The attached lake terrace and south lower extension, upper roof offsets, north elevation and small carved details are approximate. The east doorcase and attic follow the heritage inventory.
The independent original elevations are unchanged. Terrace contact and water-level registration are approximate. The lake, park and separate stable complex are outside the asset.
